release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.5.7 Release:
• Minimum Reinforcement (Min RFT) CAD Detailing Engine with AutoCAD dynamic blocks (L-BAR, S-BAR, U-BAR, KHOLY OPENING BARS, KHOLY RFT MESH).
• Merged Rebar Mats for adjacent twin columns with perimeter beam hook anchoring.
• Live AutoCAD Field formulas and dynamic property evaluations preserved without static degradation.
• Precise opening trimmer sizing with Distance1 (height) and Distance2 (width) dynamic parameters.
• Exact mesh callouts: Bottom Mesh T10-250 & Top Mesh T10-300 with configurable slab threshold.
• Automatic slab boundary dimension containment and semi-cantilever corner leg rules.
